title: Italy still obstructing asylum returns from other EU states amid simmering dispute that threatens Schengen
lede: Italy's foot-dragging on taking back asylum seekers from other EU states is contributing to a simmering dispute that risks shattering whatever trust has been restored among member states on the Schengen border-free travel zone.
